title: Jade-Leaf Wrapped Turkish Butternut Squash Kofte
description: A savory, shattering Turkish dish featuring butternut squash, wrapped in jade-leaf and cooked to perfection in a tandoor-clay pot.

ingredients.name: ground lamb
ingredients.notes: or beef, or a combination of both

instructions: Peel, seed, and dice the butternut squash into 1-inch cubes.
In a large bowl, combine the ground meat, chopped onion, minced garlic, ground cumin, sweet paprika, coarse salt, and freshly ground black pepper.
Mix well with your hands until just combined, being careful not to overmix.
Add the diced butternut squash to the bowl and mix until the squash is evenly distributed throughout the meat mixture.
Using your hands, shape the meat mixture into small kofte, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter.
Place a jade leaf in the tandoor-clay pot and brush the leaf with a small amount of olive oil.
Place 3-4 kofte in the center of the leaf, leaving a small border around the edges.
Brush the edges of the leaf with a small amount of olive oil and fold the leaf over the kofte to form a tight package.
Repeat with the remaining ingredients, forming 6-8 packages in total.
Place the packages in the preheated tandoor-clay pot and cook for 20-25 minutes, or until the meat is cooked through and the jade leaves are crispy.
Serve the kofte hot, garnished with additional jade leaves if desired.
